# Stripe Documentation

> Stripe is a payments platform. These docs cover the API and products.

## Docs

- [Testing](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md): Simulate payments to test your integration.
- [API Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/api.md)
- [Payment Intents](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents.md): Learn how to use the **Payment Intents** API for [Stripe](https://docs.stripe.com/) payments.
* [Webhooks](/webhooks.md): Listen for events on your account.

## More

- [Billing docs index](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/llms.txt): Everything about Billing.
- [Full text](https://docs.stripe.com/llms-full.txt): The whole thing in one file.
- [Stripe blog](https://stripe.com/blog): Company news.
- [Insecure](http://docs.stripe.com/insecure.md): Should be dropped.
